requirementIndex.title: WHEN `KeyboardShortcutsProvider` mounts THE SYSTEM SHALL attach exactly one `keydown` event listener at the `document` level.
WHEN `KeyboardShortcutsProvider` unmounts THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the document-level `keydown` listener it attached.
WHILE the app is running THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure no module other than `KeyboardShortcutsProvider` attaches its own `keydown` or `keyup` listener for shortcut purposes.
WHEN `KeyboardShortcutsProvider` renders THE SYSTEM SHALL render `ShortcutHelpOverlay` as part of its output.
THE SYSTEM SHALL have `KeyboardShortcutsProvider` own the registered action-handler map used to dispatch matched shortcuts to feature-registered callbacks.
THE SYSTEM SHALL define a static `SHORTCUTS: ShortcutDefinition[]` registry in `shortcuts.ts` containing entries for "search" (`⌘K`), "save" (`⌘S`), help overlay (`?`), and cancel (`Escape`).
THE SYSTEM SHALL define `ShortcutDefinition` and `ShortcutActionId` types in `types.ts`, used by the registry, matcher, and provider.
WHERE a shortcut definition does not explicitly set `allowWhileTyping` to `true` THE SYSTEM SHALL treat that shortcut as suppressed while a typing target is focused.
THE SYSTEM SHALL define the `Escape` shortcut definition with `allowWhileTyping` set to `true`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT persist shortcut key bindings to `localStorage`, cookies, or any settings UI.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT provide any rebind or customization mechanism for shortcut keys.
WHEN `matchShortcut` is invoked with a `KeyboardEvent` and the `SHORTCUTS` registry THE SYSTEM SHALL return the `ShortcutDefinition` whose key combination matches the event.
IF no registry entry's key combination matches the given `KeyboardEvent` THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have `matchShortcut` return `undefined` without throwing.
WHEN evaluating a shortcut that requires a modifier key THE SYSTEM SHALL check `event.metaKey` only, and SHALL NOT check `event.ctrlKey` as a fallback.
THE SYSTEM SHALL implement `matchShortcut` as a pure function with no side effects and no dependency on DOM listener state.
WHEN a keydown event's target is an `input`, `textarea`, `contenteditable`, or `select` element THE SYSTEM SHALL have `isTypingTarget` return `true` for that target.
WHEN a keydown event's target is none of `input`, `textarea`, `contenteditable`, or `select` THE SYSTEM SHALL have `isTypingTarget` return `false` for that target.

IF `isTypingTarget` returns `true` for the current event target AND the matched shortcut definition's `allowWhileTyping` is not `true` THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL suppress invocation of that shortcut's action.
WHERE `isTypingTarget` returns `true` for the current event target AND the matched shortcut definition's `allowWhileTyping` is `true` THE SYSTEM SHALL still invoke that shortcut's action.

THE SYSTEM SHALL treat `isTypingTarget` as the single source of truth for "is the user typing"; no other module in this feature SHALL implement separate typing-detection logic for shortcut suppression.
THE SYSTEM SHALL implement `isTypingTarget` as a pure function accepting `EventTarget | null` and returning a boolean.
WHEN the user presses `?` and the event target is not a typing target THE SYSTEM SHALL open `ShortcutHelpOverlay`.
WHEN `ShortcutHelpOverlay` is open THE SYSTEM SHALL render the list of shortcuts (keys and descriptions) derived from the `SHORTCUTS` registry.
WHEN the user presses `Escape` while `ShortcutHelpOverlay` is open THE SYSTEM SHALL close the overlay.
THE SYSTEM SHALL style `ShortcutHelpOverlay` exclusively via `ShortcutHelpOverlay.module.css` scoped styles.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT edit `src/App.css` or `src/index.css` to style the overlay or any other part of this feature.
WHEN the user presses `Escape`, regardless of the current focus or typing target, THE SYSTEM SHALL dispatch a cancel signal.
IF `ShortcutHelpOverlay` is open when `Escape` is pressed THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL close it as part of handling the cancel signal.
WHEN `Escape` is pressed while focus is in a text input, textarea, contenteditable, or select element THE SYSTEM SHALL still process the `Escape` shortcut, because its `allowWhileTyping` is `true`.
WHEN feature code calls `useShortcutAction` with `"search"` or `"save"` and a handler function THE SYSTEM SHALL register that handler for the given action id with `KeyboardShortcutsProvider`.
WHEN the component that called `useShortcutAction` unmounts THE SYSTEM SHALL unregister its handler.
WHEN the user triggers the `"search"` shortcut (`⌘K`) outside a typing target AND a handler is registered for `"search"` THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke that registered handler.
WHEN the user triggers the `"save"` shortcut (`⌘S`) outside a typing target AND a handler is registered for `"save"` THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke that registered handler.
IF a shortcut with an associated action id fires and no handler is currently registered for that action THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL no-op without throwing.
THE SYSTEM SHALL export only `KeyboardShortcutsProvider`, `useShortcutAction`, and `SHORTCUTS` from `src/keyboard-shortcuts/index.ts`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT expose `matchShortcut.ts`, `isTypingTarget.ts`, `shortcuts.ts`, `types.ts`, or other internal files for direct import by consumers outside `src/keyboard-shortcuts/`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT implement actual search or save feature behavior; wiring `useShortcutAction("search" | "save", handler)` into real features remains out of scope until those features exist.
WHEN this feature is integrated into the app THE SYSTEM SHALL add exactly one `<KeyboardShortcutsProvider>` wrapping element, plus its accompanying import statement, to `src/App.tsx`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT make any edit to `src/App.tsx` other than the `<KeyboardShortcutsProvider>` wrapper and its import.

THE SYSTEM SHALL create and own all files under `src/keyboard-shortcuts/**`, including `index.ts`, `KeyboardShortcutsProvider.tsx`, `useShortcutAction.ts`, `ShortcutHelpOverlay.tsx`, `ShortcutHelpOverlay.module.css`, `shortcuts.ts`, `matchShortcut.ts`, `isTypingTarget.ts`, `types.ts`, and associated `*.test.ts` files.
THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure no other feature adds files under `src/keyboard-shortcuts/**`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT introduce new package dependencies; the implementation SHALL use only React and browser APIs already available via the existing `package.json`.
THE SYSTEM SHALL define all modifier-based shortcuts (e.g. `"search"`, `"save"`) using `⌘` (`event.metaKey`) as the modifier.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT add a `ctrlKey`-based Windows/Linux fallback for any shortcut in this pass.
THE SYSTEM SHALL include unit tests for `matchShortcut` covering at least one matching case per registry entry and at least one non-matching case.
THE SYSTEM SHALL include unit tests for `isTypingTarget` covering `input`, `textarea`, `contenteditable`, `select`, and a non-typing element target.
